mapper.select: SELECT * FROM security_trade ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_trade (account_id, external_id, trade_date, trade_type, symbol, currency_code, quantity, amount, exchange_rate, entry_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{externalId}, #{tradeDate}, #{tradeType}, #{symbol}, #{currencyCode}, #{quantity}, #{amount}, #{exchangeRate}, #{entryId})
mapper.update: UPDATE security_trade SET account_id=#{accountId}, external_id=#{externalId}, trade_date=#{tradeDate}, trade_type=#{tradeType}, symbol=#{symbol}, currency_code=#{currencyCode}, quantity=#{quantity}, amount=#{amount}, exchange_rate=#{exchangeRate}, entry_id=#{entryId}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
